title: athyrium wardii
intro: Athyrium wardii, commonly known as Chinese lady fern or Ward's lady fern, is a species of fern in the family Athyriaceae. This plant is used in traditional Chinese medicine due to its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Athyrium wardii include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Athyrium wardii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
